trigger:onAllySpawn.how: scenario: every copy spawns a Bee Swarmling as it is played (On Spawn: Spawn), so the copies already on the field see an ally spawned

trigger:onEnemySpawn.how: scenario: both decks spawn a Bee Swarmling with every unit played (On Spawn: Spawn), so the test unit sees enemies spawned; the bees of its own side keep the two decks even

trigger:onMove.how: scenario: Restless on every copy (it steps toward a column with a foe), so the copies move

trigger:onHeal.how: scenario: Regeneration 1 on every copy (a heal it gives itself counts)

trigger:onDiscard.how: scenario: the CPU pitches a card a turn; On Discard can only pay resources or rebuild, so it runs as Rebuild 12 (the castle has 100 Health; Rebuild 4 moved nothing) and On Spawn: Rebuild 12 for the weight

trigger:onSacrifice.how: scenario: Devour 3/3 on every copy: the CPU feeds it a hand card (40% of turns), which is sacrificed

trigger:onExile.how: scenario: every copy exiles 2 cards from its graveyard as it is played (On Spawn: Exile from graveyard 2); On Exile can only pay resources or draw, so it runs as Draw 1

trigger:onChainBreak.how: scenario: Chained (breaks when the foe plays a unit) on every copy, so every copy breaks free on the foe's next play (live Chained cards break on damage; that version never broke often enough to measure)

trigger:onCharge.how: scenario: the Charge skill's own hook: Charge N - deal 2 to a random enemy (N = 1, 2, 3; the weight is at N = 2, as live cards print)

action:exile.how: damage-equivalent in a mixed deck: 5 copies among 20 vanilla, inverted on 5 copies of On Spawn: Damage D (D 0-48) vs SW's calibrated mix, 800 games a point; S = D × the damage action's measuredS per point (low confidence: the bridge puts this scale at 0.15-2.6x SW's); beyond the ladder on every baseline: more than Damage 48 (a kill a play), so only a bound
